## Release — backlog-campaign v0.27.0

### ✨ New in v0.27.0

#### Overlapping pull requests are now stacked, always

- When two open pull requests change the same files, the campaign no longer lets them race to merge and conflict. It detects the overlap up front and stacks the later PR on top of the earlier one, so they merge in order ([#1113](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1113)).
- When a stacked PR falls behind, it is brought up to date by merging, never by rebasing or force-pushing, so reviewed history stays intact.
- The campaign re-checks the stack at the key points (before dispatch, after a merge, after a conflict) and recovers on its own in each mode.
- A new gate refuses to proceed when a PR that should be stacked is not, and stacking is the only behavior: there is no setting to turn it off.
- The merge, conflict and forge documentation now describe stacking as the one way overlapping work is handled.

#### One campaign dashboard that always says where the run stands

- In Claude Code, the campaign now keeps a single Claude dashboard up to date at every checkpoint, instead of a static page ([#1133](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1133)).
- It opens on the run's state (running, waiting on you, idle, done), the turn, when the campaign last did something, and your next action with a button to the pull request.
- It then shows the numbers at a glance and the share of the campaign that is done. Below that come the work in progress with its phase, the queue of what is next, and what is blocked, grouped by reason. Your last merges come at the end.
- If the campaign stops writing its state, the dashboard shows **Stale** on its own when you open it, so a frozen page can never look like a live one ([#1126](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1126)).
- `bun run status` warns when the state has gone stale or the dashboard was never published, so a silent campaign is noticed ([#1127](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1127)).
- Blocked items are grouped by reason (another agent's lane, tracking issue, dependency, sequenced phase, merge conflict, overlap). The long list no longer buries what matters, and a note addressed to you is never folded away ([#1130](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1130)).

### 🐛 Fixed in v0.27.0

#### A bare `git` command no longer crashes the Bash hook

- The safety hook used to crash when a command was just `git` with options and no subcommand. It now lets that through instead of failing the whole tool call ([#1116](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1116)).
